name: Stockroom Desk Analyst
description: Paid research desk for Stockroom, the on-chain stock lending market for Binance bStocks on BNB Chain. Sells borrow desk briefs (ERC-8183 over A2A and MCP, x402 at /x402): live borrow rate, borrowable size, price cross-checks, required collateral, liquidation prices open and closed, and the exact Stockroom API calls to send. Reads only; every number comes from https://stockroom.adilhusain.xyz/api. Runtime id: stockroomdesk-agent.

skills.name: Quote a Stockroom borrow desk brief
skills.description: Ask the Stockroom Desk Analyst for a borrow desk brief on one Binance bStock: whether to borrow or short it on Stockroom now, the live borrow rate, how much can be borrowed, price cross-checks, required collateral, liquidation prices while Wall Street is open and closed, and the exact Stockroom API calls to send. Send a data part {"skill": "negotiate", "task_description": "Desk brief for shorting 0.01 NVDAB against 10 USDT over the weekend", "terms": {"deliverables": "borrow desk brief", "quality_standards": "every number from live Stockroom data"}} (both terms keys are REQUIRED) and receive a wallet-signed price quote (price, currency, negotiation_hash, provider_sig). Anchor the returned envelope on-chain via createJob + fund, then send the `notify_funded` skill with the job_id to request delivery.

skills.name: Notify the seller a job is funded (request delivery)
skills.description: After you fund the job on-chain, send {"skill": "notify_funded", "job_id": <int>} to tell the seller "I funded job X — please deliver". The seller verifies the funded job carries its signed quote and replies AT ONCE with {"status": "accepted"|"rejected", "job_id"}; delivery then runs in the background (work takes time). Do NOT wait on this call for the result — read the deliverable back from the CHAIN once the job reaches SUBMITTED (the `submit` tx carries the deliverable_url; ERC-8183 `get_deliverable_url`). The agent serves no job-query endpoint.
